immutability: 02/05 source and all prior evidence preserved;03/06 prepared flags false, exact final enabled closure requires new independent qualification. No test/import/process execution by this contract.

native.aggregate_delta: Top-level native:{root,owner:{path,sha256},callers:[{caller,owner:{path,sha256},log:{path,sha256}}],artifacts:{absolute path:sha256}}. Exact whole native tree, no exclusions, private owned no symlink. Existing run artifacts/readiness included unchanged in main inventory.
native.caller_namespace: parent OR exactly one sealed executor step.id; no alias/retry of an existing namespace
native.consumer: Reconstruct full native chains; bind exact caller PID/expected argv to parent/executor raw identities and times, fixed argv allowlists/root/token/labels; require all commands naturally reaped and no unresolved; resolve every query link to exact exit. Require separate existing parent closeout. New child-command records do not fabricate Host/controller action success.
native.identity: Root/caller PID+expected argv are bound before launching native children. Accepted aggregate ties actual parent/executor identity and all natural reaps to these records. Created command ownership is direct Popen child PID/argv; no invented OS start when a short-lived command exits before observation.
native.root_reservation: Native root/owner reserved once after exact release validation and before initial parent query; it is a one-use attempt marker. Root fixture setup owner is created only after exact initial identity query, never rewritten.
native.sequence: Per caller command IDs begin1 and increase by1; intent→created→exit on success; an unresolved row ends caller/run. Popen failure may have no created row/pid. Known reaped nonzero produces exit but command caller semantic guards refuse; command effect is never inferred from return alone.
native.timeouts: Retain20second captured commands and180second interactive sudo debug; no kill/terminate/contextmanager/automatic relaunch. Natural exit is recorded separately from unknown external effect. Timeout/interruption/write failure retains durable intent and known child/reap status.

readiness.budget: One existing300second parent executor phase budget starts before readiness; acceptance cutoff=min(start+90,phase_deadline). Pre/post observation checks and clamped sleep. Preparing/sealing counts against phase budget; launch receives floor(remaining), never a renewed300.
readiness.final_inspection: Normal {path,sha256} reference to exclusive <run>/readiness/<step.id>-inspection.json; no provisional inspection is passed as authority.
readiness.prior_refs: prior_signal/prior_debug each hold exact retained intent/result refs; previous_exit is immediately prior executor exit ref; parent_claim is exact original parent action claim ref.
readiness.query_link: Each raw query row retains argv/returncode/stdout/stderr/observed_wall_time_ns plus native_command described below.
readiness.request_delta: Only selected two request objects add readiness:{path,sha256}; parent executor result adds same readiness ref. Parent result still binds exact request and exit.
readiness.session: Exactly one parent resume_one session per selected step, wholly inside its parent action claim/result interval, end before corresponding executor launch. Three existing parent sessions unchanged.
readiness.stable_heads: controller_head_sha256,host_operations_sha256,recovery_head_sha256, equal before/after polling; final expected_heads also includes final inspection_sha256.

schedule.selected_steps: Exactly proposed_schedule resume_one/reconcile actions held_verified:provider and held_verified:reservoir; no other readiness records
